rubric_items.reason: Prior F-1 resolved: the new PatientDetailPage test covers REQ-1 placement and the hasAppointments wiring. Still untested: the POST/PATCH responses that now carry visitSummary, and S-2 AC1 (Completed visits a year apart).

Assertions check exact counts, keys, href, text and DOM siblings. Weak spots: REQ-6 compares against the list endpoint over two adjacent days, and the REQ-14 page test only counts rows (2), so order is never checked.

Covers 404, zero counts, past unclosed Scheduled, future Cancelled, the local-midnight day, No-show only, and the empty page with an unclosed row. Misses the S-1 AC4 one-minute-after-now upcoming boundary.

Uses Vitest+Supertest on the API and jsdom+Testing Library on the web, in the layout's folders, with ID-prefixed names, and follows the existing DoctorDetailPage routed fetch-stub pattern. Only test files changed.
Reports no test counts or coverage and defers them to the verifier. Says coverage is skipped, which matches checks.json (coverage status skip, exit 78).

findings.text: Prior F-3 still open: the change makes the POST and PATCH patient responses carry visitSummary, but the API tests only exercise GET /api/patients/:id.

cites.quote: POST and PATCH go through `get`, so they return it too, as the design notes.
REQ-2 to REQ-6, REQ-8 to REQ-14 through `GET /api/patients/:id`.

findings.suggested_fix: Add one assertion that POST /api/patients returns a zero visitSummary and that PATCH returns the current one.

findings.text: Prior F-4 still open: S-2 AC1 asks for Completed visits more than a year apart. The REQ-6 test's Completed visits are on Monday and Tuesday of one week, yet Known still says 'several days'.

cites.quote: one on a date more than a year before today and one last week
ids.monDone = (await book(app, 2, 1, MONDAY, '09:30')).body.id;
REQ-6: counts across both fixture doctors and several days match the appointment list.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a Completed appointment more than a year earlier and assert the exact completed count, or reword Known.

findings.text: Prior F-5 still open: the S-1 AC4 boundary (a Scheduled appointment starting one minute after now counts as upcoming) is not tested. The test only checks about an hour ahead and one minute past.

cites.quote: 1 Scheduled appointment that starts one minute after now
const afterThursday = testApp(db.pool, () => new Date(at(THURSDAY, '09:01')));

findings.suggested_fix: Add a clock at THURSDAY 08:59 that expects upcoming 1.

findings.text: Prior F-6 still open: the API tests depend on run order. Later it blocks read ids that the REQ-2..REQ-5 test fills, so running one test alone or reordering them breaks them.

cites.quote: const ids: Record<string, number> = {};
appointmentId: ids.tueDone, date: TUESDAY

findings.suggested_fix: Move the bookings and status changes into beforeAll so each test reads prepared state.

findings.text: The artifact says REQ-14 on other pages relies on those pages' existing tests. The test strategy says pages beyond the listed ones have no web tests, and S-5 AC5 names the appointment list and an appointment's page, which have none.

cites.quote: patient page relies on the existing tests of those pages
other pages have no web tests
the appointment list, an appointment's page, a doctor's page and the dashboard

findings.suggested_fix: State that the appointment list and appointment page have no web tests, so S-5 AC5 is uncovered there, and record it as a gap.

findings.text: Known says the page test shows the table rows unchanged, but the fixture has one appointment and the test only counts 2 rows. The S-5 AC3 order (upcoming first, then past) is never checked.

cites.quote: expect(screen.getAllByRole('row')).toHaveLength(2);
the Appointments table lists the same rows in the same order as before (upcoming first, then past)

findings.suggested_fix: Stub two appointments (one upcoming, one past) and assert the row order in the table.
